name: Absolute Ocean Charters
summary: Family-owned Broome operator running humpback whale watching and snubfin dolphin cruises, reef and creek fishing charters, and private charters. Most trips use the 65ft vessel Contessa C, with a smaller boat for creek fishing. A qualified marine biologist hosts the wildlife cruises, and free pick-up from your accommodation is included on the cruises and day charters.
standouts: Ecotourism Australia certified for 10 years, with Green Travel Leader status in 2023
Family owned and operated since 2009 by Mick and Kelly Woodley
A qualified marine biologist guides every wildlife cruise
Completed the Quality Tourism Framework and Accessible Tourism programs

trips.title: Sunset Whale Watching
trips.summary: A three hour cruise from 3pm to 6pm to watch humpback whales migrate along the Kimberley coast off Broome, finishing with a sunset on the water. A qualified marine biologist gives commentary, and guests can hear whale song through an on-board hydrophone. Free pick-up from your accommodation is included.
highlights: Sunset on the water at the end of the cruise
Qualified marine biologist host
Whale song through an on-board hydrophone
Three viewing platforms and a walk-around deck on the 65ft vessel
trips.season: Late June to early October (dates vary each year)
trips.departsFrom: Gantheaume Beach or Entrance Point, Broome (free pick-up from accommodation)
includes: Free pick-up and drop-off at your accommodation by air-conditioned courtesy bus
Transfer by the tender 'JayBee' to the vessel 'Contessa C'
Qualified marine biologist and an informative presentation throughout
Complimentary appetisers and refreshing drinks

trips.title: Sunset Snubfin Dolphin Cruise
trips.summary: A coastal eco cruise from 3pm to 6pm past Gantheaume Point, Reddell Beach and Entrance Point and into Roebuck Bay, looking for snubfin dolphins, turtles, sea snakes and shorebirds. A qualified marine biologist gives commentary and the cruise ends with a sunset on the water. Appetisers, water, tea, coffee and a drink from the licensed bar are included.

trips.title: Full Day Reef Fishing
trips.summary: A full day of reef fishing 20 to 40 nautical miles offshore from Broome on the 65ft Contessa C, going further out than the half day for a wider range of species. All fishing gear, morning tea and lunch are provided, and the crew cleans your catch and packs it on ice. Free pick-up from your accommodation is around 7am.

trips.title: Creek & Estuary Fishing Charters
trips.summary: A half day of creek and estuary fishing around Roebuck Bay on JayBee, a small open boat built for shallow creeks, with a maximum of 3 passengers. Targets include barramundi and mangrove jack, and mud crabbing is available on request. Free pick-up from your accommodation is around 7am and the trip returns to Broome around 12pm.

trips.title: Rowley Shoals Fishing and Snorkelling Trip
trips.summary: Fishing and snorkelling charters to the Rowley Shoals, leaving from Broome for a long weekend or a week. Charters are whole boat, for small groups of up to 6 passengers on live-aboard trips, and a minimum of 3 full days at the shoals (4 nights) is recommended. They run in October and November each season.

So no trip has a price and priceFrom is null throughout; the only dollar figures recorded are the exclusive charter deposit and bar drinks from $5. Left out as trips: 'Morning Whale Watching' and 'Morning Snubfin Dolphin Cruise' (they appear only as options in the booking widget; no description, time or season on the site); the 'Cruise Ship Special' (https://absoluteoceancharters.rezdy.com/647364/roebuck-bay-snubfin-dolphin-tour-cruise-ship-special sits under a heading on the snubfin dolphin page with no description); the Broome Bus Town Tour and the Cruise Special Broome Bus Town Tour (land-only, Tuesdays and Fridays 9am to 11am); the Broome Sunset Cruises page (same cruise as the sunset snubfin dolphin cruise, folded into it); and Scuba Diving Broome Charters (the /dive-charters/ link redirects to Rowley Shoals and no dive trip is described).
